I'm currently running a 30W iStick with a Kanger Sub Tank Mini. Is upgrading to a Sub Box kit worth the price? Also were is the best place to buy the Sub Box Mini starter kit. It looks like the Kangertech website is currently out of stock.

There are a couple of things to consider:

  • In addition to the Sub Box Mini, you will also have to purchase batteries and a charger, and you really shouldn't skimp on either of those. Be ready to spend more than just the sticker price on the Sub Box.

  • Are you using 30W and feeling unsatisfied? Are you looking for more battery life? Is it a safety reason? All of these things are important to sort through.
The evic vt would be awesome for your subtank. Pair it with nickle coils for temperature control. Not to mention a 5000mah built in battery. Awesome.
